---
applyTo: 'src/components/**/*.tsx'
---

# Component Guidelines

## Exports & Naming

- Use named exports: `export function MyComponent()`
- PascalCase filenames matching the component name
- Only add `'use client'` when the component uses React hooks, event handlers, or browser APIs

## Shared Components

- `<Container>` — consistent max-width (`max-w-2xl:1400px`) and horizontal padding
- `<SectionHeading>` — section titles with optional `description` prop
- `<AnimateOnScroll>` — Framer Motion scroll-triggered animations (wrap any section)
- `<StructuredData>` — JSON-LD schema injection for SEO
- `<BackToTop>` — floating scroll-to-top button

## Styling

- Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` for conditional class merging (clsx + tailwind-merge)
- Import UI primitives from `@/components/ui/`
- Brand colors: `--color-electric` (#00ffff), `--color-navy` (#1a2b3c) — defined in `globals.css`

## Critical: Base UI (NOT Radix)

- Do NOT manually edit files in `src/components/ui/` — generated by shadcn CLI
- **NO `asChild` prop** — it does not exist in Base UI
- Styled links: `<Link className={buttonVariants({ variant, size })}>` — NOT `<Button asChild>`
- SheetTrigger: apply `className` directly, never use `asChild`
- If using `buttonVariants()`, the component MUST have `'use client'`

## Animation Pattern

```tsx
import { AnimateOnScroll } from '@/components/shared/animate-on-scroll'
;<AnimateOnScroll>
  <section>...</section>
</AnimateOnScroll>
```
